title: Better Dragon Drops
description: The Ender Dragon now drops one Dragon Egg and either an Elytra or Dragon Head on death!
body:
# Better Dragon Drops
Made by [**8bitdino**](https://www.youtube.com/@8bitdino) with **100% human** trial & error :3
## Description
This datapack adds the Dragon Egg, Elytra, and Dragon Head to the Ender Dragons loot table, making them renewable!

This is designed to work with my [Better Non-Renewables Collection](https://modrinth.com/collection/uglZSVKi)!
## Loot Tables Altered
> The **Ender Dragon** now drops a **Dragon Egg** on death.

> The **Ender Dragon** now drops an **Elytra** or **Dragon Head** on death.
  > Only one of these is dropped per death to encourage End exploration :)
## IMPORTANT
> The Elytra dropped will have a durability between 1-108. This is once again to encourage base game End exploration.
## More
Please let me know if any bugs/issues arise by submitting a report through the dedicated [Google Form](https://forms.gle/UnCkA96xm5q3CV6a8)!
## Credits
Made by **8bitdino**
